xmldoc.short_description: Render the example images of Nelson help files.

param_input_item.param_description: a string: module name (module must be loaded). An empty numeric value [] selects every module that has help files.
a string: language of the help files, for example 'en_US' or 'fr_FR'. An empty value [] selects every available language.
a logical: when true, every image is rendered again, even one that is already up to date. Default: false.

description.p: xmldocrenderimages runs the examples of the help files that declare an image with example_item_img and generate="true", and saves the resulting figure next to the XML file.
An image is rendered when it is missing, empty, or older than its XML file. Use force to render it again in every case.
Each example runs in a separate nelson-adv-cli process with a 120 second timeout, several at a time. A failed example is retried up to five times before an error is raised.
Without argument, the images of every module are rendered for every available language. The function sets the language of the session while it works and restores it when done.

example_item.example_item_description: Render the missing or outdated images of one module in the current language set.
Render every image of every module in every language, even the ones already up to date.
